title: Different Class
notes:
Standard edition where the inlay is a 20-page booklet. Housed in a regular jewel case with clear tray.
Some copies with a circular sticker on front (text in capitals): "Includes the singles 'Common People' 'Mis Shapes' And 'Disco 2000' CID 8041 524165-2".
No tracks durations mentioned on this release.

Recorded and mixed at the Town House, London.
Mastered at the Town House, London.
Orchestra recorded at Air Lyndhurst, London.
